description: DMA buffers and struct lr_cpu ownership transitions finite independent example
verification_method: research/v3/verify_fixtures.py independently recomputes this declared finite example; implementation and hardware evidence remain separate
mechanism_contract: A DMA engine is another memory actor. A struct lr_cpu may not modify a buffer while DMA owns it, and a completion interrupt does not by itself fix cache visibility. Model free, struct lr_cpu-filling, device-owned, completed and struct lr_cpu-consuming states explicitly.
required_observation: Reconcile every buffer transition and verify payload bytes after actual DMA completion. Inject cancellation and stale-completion cases in the host model without claiming it simulates the bus.
